description:
Agrees to a plan and starts it. The plan it names carries the price, and this is the call that spends against the balance of whoever owns the connection.

It takes the plan id and nothing else, so what runs is what was quoted. A different set of people is a different plan, at a new price.

Runs take minutes; `orbbai_run_status` reports progress.

Spends Research Tokens.

planId.description: The `planId` from `orbbai_plan`. The only thing this takes.

name: orbbai_run_start
title: Start a Research Run
